audit.notes: Perfect match for existing laptop/desk work, coffee routine, and friend hangouts at coffee shops. No spoken audio required—only matching concise numbered tips over lifestyle b-roll cuts.
audit.summary: An aesthetic study routine video listing 5 practical tips to study for long hours, cut over cozy desk setup b-roll and café study sessions.
